newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-EX-FORMULA ONE DRIVER BLUNDELL IN ROAD SMASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-EX-FORMULA ONE DRIVER BLUNDELL IN ROAD SMASH.

text.p: British racing driver Mark Blundell was involved in a car smash on Tuesday in which a woman was seriously hurt, police said.
Three cars, including the ex-Formula One driver's Mercedes, were involved in in the accident near Cambridge.
Blundell, who now competes on the U.S. IndyCar circuit, was unhurt, but the woman suffered serious internal injuries. Hospital staff said her condition was stable.
